resources.string: Open Lumio → Pair wallet → scan. One code covers every App of this wallet.
In Rabby: Add address → Hardware wallet → AirGap Vault → Scan QR. Ethereum App only.
Add account or hardware wallet → Hardware wallet → QR-based → Continue. Ethereum App only.
Unlocking with the Duress Password erases this vault. You\'ll need your recovery phrase, and your passphrase if you set one, to get these wallets back.
